summary: Los Angeles County lookout built 1936 by Angeles NF; register says purposely burned 1969, another source says demolished before 1980; nothing remains at site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says purposely burned by USFS personnel in 1969. Peakbagging.com says demolished before 1980 with no date. Both put the end before 1980; the story uses the register's 1969 date and method and notes the difference.
Register spells West Libre; peakbagging.com and Angeles Adventures spell West Liebre. The record keeps the register spelling.

notes_for_editor: Three sources only; the fate account differs (burned 1969 vs demolished before 1980, no date) and the story says so. No staffing or fire records were found. The 1989 LA Times article about lookout cabins at Mt. Vetter and South Mt. Hawkins was read but does not cover this lookout, so it is not cited. The Angeles Adventures dates (1936-1960s) are not explained on the page.
